rules: All predicates describe existing semantics or explicitly UNAPPROVED narrow extensions; do not call potentially replaying public views/helpers on V1 reads.
No operator ClockGrant or defender grant implies Player observation.
Re-evaluate current disclosure on every submission explanation, later read, duplicate and after restore/revocation.
Original command and later causal receipts are independent. Internal receipt matching never publishes fingerprints or raw history.
A group missing because of lawful non-applicability uses NotApplicable only after its disclosure predicate passes.

Actual authoritative pre/post own-life interval observations can use the shared immediate-fact contract; historical per-operation HP/temporary HP deltas are NotRetained unless an explicit native field above stores them.
Future costs/rechecks use separate ExpeditionConditionalObligationV1; never these observed fact rows.
Native current life/condition projections must use the reviewed pure-read capability; no lifecycle Restore/AdvanceTo fallback.

disclosurePredicates.definition: Current non-revoked enabled Player seat; exact principal-bound request receipt; selected stabilization/casting or wound profile for this kind; actual fixed Hero healer and Companion patient both admitted by the existing current own-actor view. Wound requires its selected station/interval binding. This permits only the listed actual owned medical results; no other patient's/source/DC/random history. Must be agreed with GPT before implementation.

Current enabled Player seat and exact principal-bound receipt, ConnectedConsumeDecay selected, command Actor==ConsumeDecaySite.Actor and target==selected site, current own-actor view admits that actor. Historical fixed-site offer/end scalars only; existing current TemporaryHp view does not itself authorize all history.

Exact receipt gate plus current enabled Player seat, ConnectedShortRest and grant.Controls(ShortRestBerth.Actor), matching the selected ShortRest view at ConnectedExpeditionView.cs:595. Project only bound intervals/scalars already in that view.

Exact receipt gate plus current enabled Player seat, ConnectedFleshWarden and grant.Controls(FleshWardenProfile.Actor), matching the actual FleshWarden view. Bind choice and completed Change through its actual rest.

Exact receipt gate plus current enabled Player seat, ConnectedClericLongRest and grant.Controls(ClericRpProfile.Actor), matching LongRest view; per-actor recovery offers further require grant.Controls(offer.ActorId). No ClockGrant substitution.

CARE-LONG-EXISTING for the exact bound offer and current own controlled actor, plus exact recovery-response receipt and point/removal/benefit/offer causal chain. Existing LongRest offers permit selected-point explanation; proposed extension adds only recorded removal ID/point/kind/time, with no private gain/source IDs.
